Analysts See $1.02 EPS for Lumentum Holdings Inc. (LITE) Posted by Ellis Scott 32 pm
Analysts expect Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) to report $1.02 EPS on February, 5.They anticipate $0.42 EPS change or 29.17 % from last quarter’s $1.44 EPS. LITE’s profit would be $75.80M giving it 10.30 P/E if the $1.02 EPS is correct. After having $1.14 EPS previously, Lumentum Holdings Inc.’s analysts see -10.53 % EPS growth. The stock increased 1.06% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $42.01. About 943,531 shares traded. Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) has declined 10.61% since January 2, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 10.61% the S&P500.
Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. $3.12 billion. It operates through two divisions, Optical Communications and Commercial Lasers. It has a 9.37 P/E ratio. The Optical Communications segment offers components, modules, and subsystems that enable the transmission and transport of video, audio, and text data over high-capacity fiber optic cables.
